summary: The earlier draft failed to hold the discharge air temperature setpoint low during startup and restart windows, returning values above expected. The edge-triggered hold combined with inverted enable and OR logic did not keep the forcing active through the needed interval. The later draft replaced that network with a delayed enable inverted to drive the low selection, and it passed every scenario.

changes.title: Replace edge hold network with delayed enable inversion
changes.text: Removed `enableEdge`, `startupHold`, `notEnable` and `offOrStartup` with their wires to `forceLowSel`, and added `startupDelay` fed from enable with `startupNot` driving `forceLowSel` so the low request remains asserted through the startup interval that previously showed high setpoint in the startup and restart scenarios.
